Blocks.Text: The latest API version is 202604. Use this version in the LinkedIn-Version header for all API requests to access the most recent features and improvements.

The InMail History API allows you to retrieve InMail activity, both sent and received, that occurred on a given LinkedIn Recruiter contract. In order to properly store and associate these InMails within your application, you will need to already have retrieved the LinkedIn seat URN for the Recruiter seatholders and the member URN for the prospects.
It is recommended to make calls to this API on a periodic basis using a batch process. Set the time range to be no more than 12 hours per call, or more frequently as needed (e.g. every 30 minutes).
All API requests require authorization. Additionally, API requests return paged results; details on paging through results can be found here.
Unlimited InMails can be sent to your 1st degree connection in your development environment provisioned by LinkedIn.
Details for the API are below.
Retrieve message history between seat holders and prospects.

Rows.Text: Find InMails (sent and received) associated with a specific Recruiter Seatholder.
Find InMails that were sent and received on or after a specific date.
Find InMails that were sent and received before a specific date.
Thread URN in the format urn:li:messagingThread:{id}
Find InMails (sent and received) associated with a specific Thread

Blocks.Text:
The response will contain the list of events belonging to a conversation. Events have an author, a time that it was created and the mail content.
Both private and public InMail messages associated with the viewer will be returned in this api call.
The response body fields are described below.

Rows.Text: The participant that created this event. If the mail is sent by the candidate this field will contain a Person URN else if the email is sent by the recruiter this field will contain a Recruiter seatholder URN.
Author URN will be in format urn:li:seat:{id} or urn:li:person:{id}
The content of this event, for example mail item with a subject and body.
Time when the event was created.
The entity ID of the Event. It is a unique identifier for each InMail event
The list of all participants designated to receive this event. This field will contain the list of URNs.
String[]. Array will contain URNs in the format urn:li:seat:{id} or urn:li:person:{id}
Thread URN in the format urn:li:messagingThread:{id}

Blocks.Text: This defines the content of a mail item. It represents an item in the mail inbox.

Rows.Text: The body of the mail. This field holds the content of the body in the text field as described in the sample response body below.
